item.title: Kyonyuu Shoujo no Ero Pet
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: ATELIER G/H
  • 発売日: 2017-11-22
  • スコア: 5.9/10 (29 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 巨乳少女のエロ犬
  • 英語名: Kyonyuu Shoujo no Ero Pet

あらすじ

The protagonist went to a certain region for utilizing his long vacation.

It was a small town situated between the sea and mountains.

While it had not been mentioned in the sightseeing guidebook, despite being small hot spring village, it seemed to have taken the world by storm.

But along the path, trying to avoid colliding with a “stray dog”, the protagonist’s car crashed into the guardrail.

item.title: Hachinin no Mazokko
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: ATELIER G/H
  • 発売日: 2014-06-20
  • スコア: 6.57/10 (21 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 8人のM娘
  • 英語名: Hachinin no Mazokko

别名

  • 八人のM娘（まぞっこ）

あらすじ

Akio Yokosuka is a teacher who works at a prestigious girls’ school. He dreams of a loving relationship with a masochist girl, but all that appears before him are uncaring, self-centered girls.

One day, though, after collapsing from too much stress, Akio wakes up with a new ability. He can now see through girls with hidden “masochism’'.

item.title: Gakuen NTR ~Boku no Shiranai Kanojo no Kao~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: ATELIER G/H
  • 発売日: 2013-01-25
  • スコア: 6.55/10 (77 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 学園NTR ～僕の知らない彼女の淫顔～
  • 英語名: Gakuen NTR Boku no Shiranai Kanojo no Kao

あらすじ

Yuuto, a high schooler, is sick of being a virgin. He wants to have a girlfriend before the end of the summer term.

After getting rejected by his classmate, Maina, he wants to aim big. His future girlfriend has to be one of the school’s idols.

Luckily there are Hina and Miya, his classmates who work as bikini models for cheesecake advertisments. Yuuto is not the only one who has taken an interest in them, though.

item.title: Mahou Shoujo Pure Saints ~Makechau Tabi ni, Dondon Ecchi na Seigi no Heroine ni Natte Icchau no~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: ATELIER G/H
  • 発売日: 2012-06-01
  • スコア: 6.51/10 (17 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 魔法少女ピュア・セインツ～負けちゃうたびに、どんどんエッチな正義のヒロインになっていっちゃうの～
  • 英語名: Mahou Shoujo Pure Saints Makechau Tabi ni, Dondon Ecchi na Seigi no Heroine ni Natte Icchau no

あらすじ

A certain city in Japan.

Since the appearance of the villian Mask de Roman, some people are able to affect others with the power of their erotic delusions.

Naito, a student, enjoys his daily life with this power, secretly hoping that one day, he’ll be able to transform his whole school into a lewd place.
